package.description: Engage every student in a playful STEAM learning

en-US.description: Engage every student in a playful STEAM learning
en-US.longDescription: The SPIKE App is a student-facing app that can be used with both SPIKE Essential and SPIKE Prime to follow and complete lessons. The app includes “getting started” material, lessons, building instructions, and a series of coding experiences that progress from icon- and word-block coding based on Scratch to text-based coding based on Python.
en-US.name: LEGO Education SPIKE

zh-CN.description: 让每位学生都参与到有趣的 STEAM 学习中
zh-CN.longDescription: SPIKE App 应用程序是一款面向学生的应用程序，可以与 SPIKE 科创基础套装和 SPIKE Prime 科创套装结合使用，有助于引导和完成课程。该 App 应用程序包含“入门”材料、课程、搭建手册，以及一系列编程体验，从基于 Scratch 的图标和词语模块编程到基于 Python 的文本化编程。
